upgrade_notice: IMAP reliability, responsive emails, faster inbox delivery, and new admin Design settings.
description: TempMail Pro — A full-featured temporary/disposable email SaaS platform for WordPress with subscriptions, multi-domain, payments, and analytics.
changelog:
v2.0.1 — 2026-05-22

  • New: Recursive MIME parser — fixes No HTML content for multipart emails.
  • New: Burst polling — re-polls every 5s for 30s after new email arrives.
  • New: Refresh button triggers live IMAP fetch immediately.
  • New: Background IMAP poll interval reduced from 30s to 15s.
  • New: Responsive email rendering — strips inline min-width and fixed widths.
  • New: Mail Server Setup Guide with 4 hosting-type tabs.
  • New: WP-Cron Setup step in admin guide.
  • New: Design tab in Settings — theme, accent colour, font, width, custom CSS.
  • New: Plugin row notice — shows what’s new on every install.
  • Fixed: poll_socket_imap() rewritten to RFC822 — works on all IMAP servers.
  • Fixed: Email iframe horizontal scrollbar on mobile.
  • Fixed: Design settings not saving (missing from save whitelist).
  • Fixed: address-bar not applying light theme (data-theme now set in PHP).

v2.0.0 — 2026-05-17

  • New: Full SaaS platform with subscriptions, payments, analytics, OAuth.
